punchline: The surgeons who learned microsurgery in a single day were the ones who damaged the rats' vessels beyond repair.
thirty_sec: Thirty-eight surgical residents learn to reattach tiny vessels in four short lessons. Half get them all in one day, half a week apart. A month later they operate on live rats. The spaced group is faster, uses fewer movements and succeeds more often; 16 percent of the one-day group can't finish at all. Make It Stick's point: a little forgetting between sessions makes recall harder, and that effort is what makes the skill stick.
